title: A cooling-tower maker says a drawing search fell from an hour to 4.5 minutes
friendlyTitle: Engineers now find an old drawing in 4.5 minutes, the company says
summary: OpenAI's 9 November customer story says Kuken Industries, a Japanese cooling-tower maker, built a search tool on the OpenAI API with partner Recursive. Engineers can look up 70 years of drawings by part number or by pasting a screenshot. Kuken says a search now takes 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour, and expects about 90 percent fewer hours spent searching over a year.
friendlySummary: Kuken Industries makes cooling towers in Japan. Its drawings go back 70 years. With a tool built on the OpenAI API, engineers can search by part number or by pasting a picture. Kuken says a search now takes 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour.
whyItMatters: The numbers are the company's, from its own tests. The practical change is that a newer engineer can find the original drawing without asking a veteran where the file lives. Kuken is also testing a checker that flags mismatches in partner drawings. In a prototype, it says about 90 percent of the flags were real. That checker is not in production.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Those numbers come from the company, not from an outside test. The useful part is that a new engineer can find the right drawing without asking a veteran where it is. A second tool that checks drawings for mistakes is still a prototype.
